keeps.name: Holly Point Campground (Falls Lake SRA)
keeps.waterfront_evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Distance to Body of Water': drive-in sites 119, 121, 122, 123, 126, 127 (Loop 4) and 059 (Loop 2) at 40 ft, 065, 066, 071 (Loop 2), 129 (Loop 4) and 151 (Loop 5) at 50 ft; NC911 leaf-off imagery (2025-02) at 36.0027,-78.6557 shows the Loop 4 cul-de-sac pads ~15-20 m from the Falls Lake shore across open, thinly treed ground with no road or day-use strip between; Loop 2's tip at 36.0066,-78.6522 sits between two coves. Pool ~252 ft (77 m), campground ~107 m, dam far downstream. Agrees with AWH's firsthand note, which AWH confirmed 2026-10-22 describes Holly Point.
keeps.inclusion_evidence: ncparks.gov Falls Lake camping page (read 2026-10-22): 'Holly Point offers 158 campsites total, 89 with water and 50/30-amp electric hookups', dump station; ReserveAmerica 552902 lists 147 Holly Point sites in Loops 1-5, 137 drive-in (site-detail driveway lengths 35-135 ft, 50-amp electric in Loops 1, 2, 3 and 5). Temporarily closed for wastewater construction (see status).
keeps.note: Wooded campground with multiple lakefront RV sites.  --AWH The waterside sites are the non-electric ones at the ends of Loops 2 and 4, and several in Loop 2 are walk-in. --Claude

status.reopens: November 16, 2026 (Loops 2-4); Loops 1 and 5 closed for construction, no date published
status.note: NC State Parks (construction-impacts post, last updated 9/15/2026): 'Holly Point campground is closed for construction and will reopen by November 16, 2026' (wastewater system upgrade). The park's 2026 operating schedule lists Loops 2, 3 and 4 opening November 16, 2026 and Loops 1 and 5 'Closed for Construction'.

adds.name: Rolling View Campground (Falls Lake SRA)
adds.note: Three wooded loops on a point of Falls Lake off Baptist Road, with a swim beach, boat ramp and fishing pier in the day-use area beside the campground. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: ncparks.gov Falls Lake camping page (read 2026-10-22): 'Rolling View offers 115 campsites total, 80 with water and 50/30-amp electric hookups', dump station; ReserveAmerica 552902 lists 111 drive-in Rolling View sites (Loop A/B 50-amp electric, Loop C non-electric), site-detail driveway lengths 37-154 ft.
adds.waterfront_evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Distance to Body of Water' for all 111 Loop A/B/C sites is 205 ft or more (B-015 205, B-014 230, A-025/A-026 230; Loop C 315+); NC911 leaf-off imagery (2025-02) at 36.0128,-78.7238 shows the nearest Loop B pads ~40-60 m from Falls Lake behind a continuous wooded slope, with the fishing pier and day-use area between. No pad within the on-water bound and no open sightline -> not waterfront.

excluded.name: B.W. Wells Campground
excluded.reason: Group camping only, hike-in: 'B.W. Wells has 11 group campsites that are hike-in only'; group camping 'is for tents only — no RVs or trailers allowed' (ncparks.gov camping page). ReserveAmerica: 'B.W. Wells Group Camp (Hike-In)', 11 Improved Group Camping sites.

excluded.name: Shinleaf Campground
excluded.reason: Hike-in tent camping: 'Shinleaf offers tent camping in 46 hike-in sites' (ReserveAmerica 'Shinleaf Campground (Hike-In)'); its nine drive-up sites are group camps, tents only, no RVs or trailers.

excluded.name: Rolling View Group Camp
excluded.reason: Four hike-in group tent sites (no RVs or trailers); part of Rolling View, not a separate RV campground.
